If your purchase does not work out, here are your options:

For online orders, you can return items within 30 days of delivery for a change of mind. Returns can be made at any Barkers store or sent back using the free prepaid courier label included with your order.
For in-store purchases, you have 14 days for a full refund. Between 14 and 30 days, you can receive an exchange or store credit.
Exchanges for a different size or style are available both online and in-store.
If your item is faulty, Barkers will arrange a repair, replacement, refund, or store credit depending on the issue.

Please note:

Items must be in original condition, unwashed, and with all labels attached unless faulty.
Worn, washed, damaged, or altered items cannot be returned for change of mind.
Refunds are processed to the original payment method. Barkers Dollars are refunded to your account, and Barkers coupons are non-refundable.
